title: Conditional kappa 0.001017250500928266: ordered sequential entrance gauges
body:
Promote ten existing entrance donors to pivots using an ordered two-layer construction: conditional **κ = 0.001017250500928266** (`508625250464133/500000000000000000`), **+0.07681919% over #406**.

The new mechanism goes beyond #404's pivot/donor disjointness. Prepend 51 literal entrance shears to #406; every source is read before it is written by a later entrance gate. The resulting prefix is `S = I + N` with **N² nonzero (148 entries), N³ = 0**, and explicit inverse `I - N + N²`, realized by the actual reversed elementary word. Reversing the entrance layers fails an exact gauged-dirt control.

Gauge count increases **194 → 204**. All 1021 raw columns, retained totals, actual nested paths and all 204 zero response columns are checked exactly. Local paid delta is `{3:+9,4:-8,5:-1}`, reducing local rank mass by ten. The original #404 shared-donor construction, overlapping target recovery, credited #376 frame edit and #402/#406 target re-synthesis remain included.

Repack the changed residual inventory over **32 replicas**: 2947 banks per stage, 1531 rank-one paddings; live 57243, physical58034. All 288 invocations and 117504 boundary adapters are charged. Fresh invoice: local bound `7845447935020`, per-vertex bound `2509741657493211`, row `15449 < 20161`.

Complex lower: `101828635323117962043/100000000000000000000000`. Bit lower: `255384852701747/250000000000000000`.

**Full local wrapper attempt:** the fresh complete #406 baseline passed (132.66 s), followed by the entire new packaged constructor/local/phases/global/invoice/outer build (108.82 s). The final bit replay stopped while linking `legality-r822`: `errno=28 (No space left on device)`. This failed run and its logs are retained. **Still pending:** one uninterrupted complete wrapper pass and the Python3.11/3.14 CI matrix; GitHub jobs are queued. Separate local component passes do not establish that end-to-end wrapper result. Draft-first submission as requested. CI retains failed outputs.

Run `python -B research/e8-sequential-gauges/verify.py /tmp/sequential-gauges`. The wrapper first freshly executes the entire #406 wrapper (including full #404), then reconstructs and checks this extension, then freshly replays bit composition. The only local-admission relaxation replaces the global disjoint-source/target assertion with the exact chronological read-before-write premise. All scalar, symbolic, phase, lifecycle, source-pin and omission checks remain. `LOCAL-ADAPTATION.json` records the change; `PROOF.md` proves why the omission formula remains valid. The immutable #403 bank emitter/independent decoder/bridge are rerun with the new replica count and witness.

Discovery screened 53440 weighted bases, exactly admitted four groups, then screened 51200 more on the extended word with no additional positive nomination. Accepted coefficients and full costs are exact; discovery scores and bounded negative screens are not global optimality claims.

### Legacy-checker compatibility audit

After #407 reported legacy-checker rejections, we reproduced them independently. This word does **not** pass the unchanged `gx.check1`/`gxcore` pipeline: E4 rejects the inherited overlapping target dependency, and the fixed-sixths dirty replay rejects an intermediate quarter coefficient. The exact x-content and gauged-response checks pass separately. An independent rational replay over all1021 raw input columns finds denominator powers at most 2² and 3¹ (a common denominator12), with maximum absolute coefficient4; this observation covers the raw main word, not an all-size compiler theorem.

Our finite admission deliberately uses the exact chronological120-column target identity in place of the disjoint-role E4 sufficient condition, and charges literal HALVE/DIVIDE3 operations in the dyadic/divisor3 framework (`odd_grid = 2^(-P)3^(-G(D+1))`). Both full formal dirty orientations are checked directly. These facts do not turn the result into a legacy gx/Lean certificate: the already stated all-size compiler, common-grid and precision interfaces remain conditional. Comparisons with #407's checker-clean construction must retain this distinction.
